response.reason: The Cody-Waite reduction computes q*1.5703125 in FP32; for large FP16 inputs (e.g. x near 65504, q ≈ 41651) the product needs ~25 significant bits, so its rounding introduces an absolute error of up to ~2e-3 in r, which propagates directly into the sine result and far exceeds the required 1e-6 absolute tolerance.
